What if you fell into a black hole?
on the size of the black hole.
Fall into a small one, a few times the mass of our Sun, and gravity pulls much harder on your feet than on your head.
But a supermassive black hole, like the giant one at the center of our galaxy, is gentler at the edge.
You could cross the point of no return...
To a friend watching from far away, you'd never actually fall in.
But for you, time runs normally.
Two versions of the same story...
